decision: Started coordination-only implementation node for the only planned phase.

Accepted Team Composition Proposal as default. Hard rules checked: test-dev required because production code changes are planned; security-reviewer remains mandatory for review owner after build PASS; no backend/scaffold role by default; no concurrency-reviewer by default because phase lacks concurrency-review tag.
Selected phase-01 as active phase; it is the only phase and has no dependencies.

Deterministic review owner is frontend-dev because plan/phase-01 has frontend.md and no backend.md. Review owner must raise code-reviewer, architect-reviewer, security-reviewer, and completeness-reviewer after its own build PASS. Lead remains passive in build/review unless fallback/error occurs.

Role-specific Kent --agent roles are unavailable in this environment; workers are raised as default Kent subagents with explicit role-file assignments. Review owner is instructed to spawn reviewers the same way after build PASS. This preserves role-file ownership while avoiding a known named-role launch failure.
Wrote self-contained assignments for frontend-dev review owner and test-dev worker. No backend/firebase/integration/concurrency worker assigned by default.
Started frontend-dev review owner and test-dev worker in one background batch, with outputs redirected to run/agents. Lead now waits; build and review are owned by frontend-dev.
test-dev completed its write scope in AppShellScreenTest.kt and reported scenario coverage; Gradle gate intentionally not run by test-dev.

Initial worker batch exited with status 0 for frontend-dev and test-dev. Frontend-dev returned ERROR instead of final phase RESULT because Build Status did not reach PASSED; mandatory reviewers were not started.

Implementation and test changes are applied, but Gradle/build gate is blocked by environment-repo hygiene: invalid local.properties sdk.dir, missing apps/android-next/google-services.json, and recurring AppleDouble ._* files corrupting Android/Kotlin intermediates. Non-Gradle guards passed. Route to debug.
